name: Pot -Rondo for Dears-
source:
A restaurant is about to be closed, and Issei is ordered to whittle down part-time workers. Shizuka, Kimika, Rinne, Asuha and Hiyori. About two months are left until closedown... Each girl spends time at the restaurant with each feeling... Issei faces it and finds his way as well. Make it unforgettable, with girls....

[From ErogeShop]
translation:
一家餐厅即将停业，一诚奉命裁减兼职员工。静、纪美香、凛音、明日叶和日和。距离关门还剩约两个月……每名女孩都怀着各自的感情，在餐厅里度过最后的时光……一诚也直面这一切，并找到自己的道路。与女孩们共同留下永生难忘的回忆……

[摘自ErogeShop]
